Kolkata Billboard Removal Sparks Scuffle, Arrests Involving Abhishek Banerjee

Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) officials removed a billboard from Abhishek Banerjee's Camac Street office. The action led to a scuffle, and thirteen individuals were subsequently arrested. The incident involved clashes with police, and the billboard was identified as belonging to the Trinamool Congress.
